upgrade_long_desc: Increases the damage of all heroes.
Increases the speed at which a hero can attack.
Increases the distance that a hero can "see" to attack an enemy or synergize with other heroes.
Increases the amount of gold earned from killing enemies.
Increases the rank exp that a hero earns from killing enemies.
Increases the effects of a hero's skill.
Reduces the time a hero must wait before using a skill again.
Increases the bonus stats earned from active hero synergies.
Increases the bonus stats earned from hero level milestones.
Increases the chance that a hero gains 2x Skill Mastery exp.
